zh.summary: 以 AppTest 重演缺漏、補正與輸入變更，檢查 Streamlit 元件和狀態；實際下載與鍵盤另外驗證。
objectives: 用 AppTest 建立並重跑 Streamlit 情境。
檢查錯誤、成功、保留輸入及下載元件狀態。
分清模擬測試與真實瀏覽器驗證範圍。

readingGuide.goal: 用 AppTest 建立並重跑 Streamlit 情境。
readingGuide.startingPoint: 自己的第三切片副本，含 app.py、rules.py、tests/ 及 Streamlit 1.51.0。
readingGuide.route: 先理解情境與原理，再對照工作坊檔案，最後留下可核對的操作與審查紀錄。
readingGuide.output: 一份 AppTest 回歸腳本，加上分開記錄的真實瀏覽器驗證。

sections.heading: 規則正確，還要確認畫面有接對
paragraphs: rules.py 拒絕缺件，不代表 app.py 一定顯示正確提示。按鈕可能沒呼叫規則、成功訊息可能沒清除，或修改輸入後仍留下下載入口。介面測試把使用者操作與畫面結果連起來。
AppTest 模擬 Streamlit app，可設定 widget 值、執行程式並檢查顯示內容與 Session State。本課採固定 1.51.0；實際支援行為以該版本與本次執行結果為準。

sections.heading: 像用操作腳本反覆走一條櫃臺流程
paragraphs: 操作腳本會指出先填哪個欄位、何時按檢查、應看到什麼。只檢查櫃臺存在，無法知道填錯時是否有人告知如何修正。
AppTest 幫你重複執行這條腳本，但它不是站在實際瀏覽器前的使用者；畫面排版、鍵盤焦點與下載位元組需要另外觀察。

sections.heading: 輸入、重跑與觀察要連在一起
paragraphs: 建立 AppTest 後呼叫 run() 產生初始畫面；變更 widget 或按按鈕後，再明確 run()，才檢查該次結果。不要把上一個重跑留下的值當成本次操作已執行。
範例以穩定 key 找三個欄位；按鈕只有一個主要檢查動作，因此使用 at.button[0]。如果你的專案新增多個按鈕，先調整定位方式，不讓測試誤按另一個動作。

blocks.caption: 圖 1｜三個連續的驗收狀態
blocks.description: 每一步都更新輸入並重跑，觀察當次結果。

items.title: 缺漏
items.body: 只填兩欄，按檢查後有缺漏提示，無完整下載。

items.title: 補正
items.body: 補齊第三欄並檢查，出現成功與下載元件。

items.title: 變更
items.body: 清空第三欄並重跑，舊成功、下載與快照失效。

sections.heading: 完整的介面測試範例
paragraphs: 在自己的第三切片副本建立 tests/test_app_contract.py，與 app.py 及 rules.py 保持同一專案結構。Path 依測試檔位置尋找 app.py，避免依啟動 shell 的偶然位置猜測入口。
每階段都檢查不應出現的狀態；只有正向成功斷言，無法保護缺漏拒絕或過期結果失效。

blocks.heading: tests/test_app_contract.py
paragraphs: 使用已安裝 Streamlit 1.51.0 與 pytest 的環境執行。
blocks.code:
from pathlib import Path
from streamlit.testing.v1 import AppTest


def test_input_change_invalidates_report():
    app = str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "app.py")
    at = AppTest.from_file(app).run()
    assert not at.exception
    at.text_input(key="application_id").input("SYN-001")
    at.text_input(key="applicant_code").input("DEMO-A")
    at.button[0].click().run()
    assert "缺少文件類型" in at.error[0].value
    assert at.text_input(key="application_id").value == "SYN-001"
    assert not at.success
    assert not at.get("download_button")
    at.text_input(key="document_type").input("合成申請表").run()
    at.button[0].click().run()
    assert not at.exception
    assert at.success
    assert len(at.get("download_button")) == 1
    at.text_input(key="document_type").input("").run()
    assert not at.exception
    assert not at.success
    assert not at.get("download_button")
    assert "checked" not in at.session_state

sections.heading: 從元件驗證走到真實瀏覽器
paragraphs: 在專案根目錄執行 python -m pytest -q tests/test_app_contract.py，再啟動 app.py，用鍵盤完成相同任務。下載 JSON 後讀取檔名、中文、status、scope 與允許欄位。
AppTest 中下載元件出現只是狀態證據，未證明檔案真的送到裝置。真實瀏覽器也不會替代人是否理解提示的任務觀察；三者要各自留下結果。

rows: 真實檔案位元組與檔名
真實瀏覽器與尺寸檢查

sections.heading: 先看失敗原因，再決定修哪裡
paragraphs: 若 AppTest 出現例外，先檢查路徑、依賴與程式輸出；若只是定位不到元件，確認目前階段真的有該元件。不要把第一切片拿來跑第三切片下載情境，再把差距當作錯誤修掉。
測試腳本的行為與自己的規格不同時，先確認需求差異。不得為了讓測試變綠，把未確認的欄位、登入或外部服務偷偷加入作品。

exercise.environment: 自己的第三切片副本，含 app.py、rules.py、tests/ 及 Streamlit 1.51.0。
steps: 加入完整測試，在專案根目錄執行並保存結果。
逐步指出缺漏、補正及變更各由哪些斷言保護。
啟動真實瀏覽器重演，另外讀取下載 JSON，記錄鍵盤與下載結果。
exercise.expected: 一份 AppTest 回歸腳本，加上分開記錄的真實瀏覽器驗證。
exercise.check: 每次操作有明確重跑；過期結果與下載消失受到檢查，不把模擬元件當真實下載證據。
exercise.cleanup: 停止本次啟動的服務，保留合成作品、Diff 與實際結果；不要覆蓋其他工作或留下真實資料。

en.summary: Replay omissions, correction and input changes with AppTest to inspect Streamlit components and state; verify real downloads and keyboard behavior separately.
objectives: Create and rerun Streamlit scenarios with AppTest.
Check errors, success, retained input and download-component state.
Separate simulation coverage from real-browser verification.

readingGuide.goal: Create and rerun Streamlit scenarios with AppTest.
readingGuide.startingPoint: Your slice-three copy with app.py, rules.py, tests/ and Streamlit 1.51.0.
readingGuide.route: Understand the situation and principles, compare the workshop files, then retain verifiable operation and review records.
readingGuide.output: An AppTest regression script with separately recorded real-browser verification.

sections.heading: Correct Rules Still Need the Right Interface Connection
paragraphs: rules.py rejecting incomplete input does not establish correct feedback in app.py. A button may fail to call rules, success may remain stale or input changes may leave a download available. Interface tests connect operations to displayed results.

AppTest simulates a Streamlit app, allowing widget values, script execution, display inspection and Session State checks. This course pins 1.51.0; rely on that version’s supported behavior and actual execution.

sections.heading: Replay a Counter-service Script
paragraphs: An operation script says which field to fill, when to check and what should appear. Merely establishing that a counter exists says nothing about correction guidance after invalid input.
AppTest repeats this script but is not a person using a real browser. Observe layout, keyboard focus and download bytes separately.

sections.heading: Connect Input, Rerun and Observation
paragraphs: After creating AppTest, call run() for the initial screen. After changing widgets or pressing a button, explicitly run() before checking the new result. Values retained from an earlier rerun do not establish that the new action executed.

The example locates three fields by stable keys. With one primary check action, it uses at.button[0]. If your project has more buttons, adjust targeting first so the test does not trigger another action.

blocks.caption: Figure 1 | Three Consecutive Acceptance States
blocks.description: Update input and rerun at each step, observing the current result.

items.title: Omission
items.body: Fill two fields and check; expect missing-data feedback without complete download.

items.title: Correction
items.body: Fill the third field and check; expect success and a download component.

items.title: Change
items.body: Clear the third field and rerun; old success, download and snapshot become invalid.

sections.heading: A Complete Interface Test
paragraphs: Create tests/test_app_contract.py in your slice-three copy, retaining app.py and rules.py in the same project structure. Path locates app.py relative to the test file instead of guessing from the launching shell’s directory.
Assert absent states at each stage too. Positive success assertions alone do not protect omission rejection or stale-result invalidation.

blocks.heading: tests/test_app_contract.py
paragraphs: Run with Streamlit 1.51.0 and pytest installed. The retained Chinese omission text, synthetic input and stable keys match the actual reference interface.
blocks.code:

sections.heading: Move from Components to a Real Browser
paragraphs: From the project root, run python -m pytest -q tests/test_app_contract.py, then start app.py and perform the same task by keyboard. Download JSON and inspect filename, Chinese content, status, scope and allowed fields.

A download component in AppTest is state evidence, not proof of file delivery to a device. A real browser also cannot replace observing whether a person understands feedback; keep separate results for all three.

blocks.caption: Table 1 | This Tool’s Verification Scope
rows: Whether the specification itself is correct.

sections.heading: Read the Failure Before Choosing the Repair
paragraphs: For AppTest exceptions, inspect paths, dependencies and output. For an unlocated component, check whether the current stage includes it. A third-slice download test is not appropriate for slice one; do not “repair” that intentional difference.
If a test differs from your specification, clarify requirements first. Do not silently add unconfirmed fields, login or external services just to make tests green.

exercise.environment: Your slice-three copy with app.py, rules.py, tests/ and Streamlit 1.51.0.
steps: Add the complete test, run it from the project root and retain results.
Identify assertions protecting omission, correction and change at each step.
Replay in a real browser and read the downloaded JSON separately, recording keyboard/download outcomes.
exercise.expected: An AppTest regression script with separately recorded real-browser verification.
exercise.check: Each operation has an explicit rerun. Check removal of stale results/downloads; simulated components are not real-download evidence.
exercise.cleanup: Stop only services you started for this exercise. Keep synthetic work, diffs and actual results; preserve other work and leave no real data.

options: 明確 run() 後檢查當次狀態

en.prompt: After changing an AppTest widget, how should you inspect new results?
options: Call run() explicitly, then inspect the current state.
rationales: The new scenario may not have executed.
That is not an operation-testing step.

zh.prompt: 哪項需要另做真實瀏覽器驗證？
options: 模擬中的 error 文字
下載檔案實際位元組與鍵盤焦點
模擬中的 success 元件
rationales: 超出本 AppTest 腳本的證明範圍。

options: The checked value in Session State.
Actual download bytes and keyboard focus.
rationales: These exceed the proof scope of this AppTest script.

zh.prompt: 清空第三欄後應檢查什麼？
options: 舊成功、下載與 checked 都失效
rationales: 完整覆蓋本課失效要求。

en.prompt: What should you check after clearing the third field?
options: The old report can still download.
Old success, download and checked are all invalidated.
rationales: These cover the course’s invalidation requirement.
